source_note: MIT OCW 24.213 Philosophy of Film (Fall 2004): Calendar page (https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/24-213-philosophy-of-film-fall-2004/pages/calendar/) for session titles/order/films, Readings page (https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/24-213-philosophy-of-film-fall-2004/pages/readings/) for per-session reading assignments, plus the Syllabus and course home for the course description; fetched 2026-10-21.

lectures.title: Introduction
lectures.summary: Opening session of the seminar, listed in the calendar as a screening of Cocteau's Beauty and the Beast (1946) with no assigned reading. It introduces the course's philosophical analysis of film as an art form.

lectures.title: Citizen Kane (1941)
lectures.summary: Session on Welles's Citizen Kane (1941), paired with the opening pages (i-xiv, 1-50) of Singer's Reality Transformed: Film as Meaning and Technique, the course's own text on how films create meaning through technique.

lectures.title: The Purple Rose of Cairo (1985)
lectures.summary: Session on Allen's The Purple Rose of Cairo (1985), with a further assigned chapter of Reality Transformed (pp. 53-78).

lectures.title: Death in Venice (1971)
lectures.summary: Session on Visconti's Death in Venice (1971), with Reality Transformed pp. 81-127 assigned.

lectures.title: The Rules of the Game (1939)
lectures.summary: Session on Renoir's The Rules of the Game (1939), the longest assigned stretch of Reality Transformed (pp. 131-189).

lectures.title: The 39 Steps (1935)
lectures.summary: Session on Hitchcock's The 39 Steps (1935), completing the assigned reading of Reality Transformed (pp. 191-200).

lectures.title: Psycho (1960)
lectures.summary: Session on Hitchcock's Psycho (1960), opening the unit on Singer's Three Philosophical Filmmakers: Hitchcock, Welles, Renoir (pp. ix-46 assigned).

lectures.title: Camera Three: The Illustrated Hitchcock (1972)
lectures.summary: Class screens the 1972 interview program Camera Three: The Illustrated Hitchcock with Pia Lindstrom, with Three Philosophical Filmmakers pp. 46-75 assigned.

lectures.title: Vertigo (1958)
lectures.summary: Session on Hitchcock's Vertigo (1958), with Three Philosophical Filmmakers pp. 77-145 assigned.

lectures.title: Orson Welles: Stories From a Life in Film (1989)
lectures.summary: Class screens the 1989 BBC interview Orson Welles: Stories From a Life in Film by Leslie Megahey, with Three Philosophical Filmmakers pp. 147-178 assigned; the calendar notes the first paper is due this session.

lectures.title: The Magnificent Ambersons (1942)
lectures.summary: Session on Welles's The Magnificent Ambersons (1942), with Three Philosophical Filmmakers pp. 178-219 assigned.

lectures.title: The Crime of Monsieur Lange (1936)
lectures.summary: Session on Renoir's The Crime of Monsieur Lange (1936), completing the assigned reading of Three Philosophical Filmmakers (pp. 221-257).

lectures.title: Discussion
lectures.summary: Final discussion session, listed with Renoir's Le Roi d'Yvetot from Petit Theatre de Jean Renoir (1971); the calendar notes the second paper is due.
